items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: So I got to hang in the truck with Glyn Johns and he would get the mix up and tell stories.

ctx.x: I’m going to quote you on that, that’s a great way to put it. So, any particular memorable encounters with some of the musicians, the bands, during your tenure there?

After I was there for about a year I was lucky to go on tour with the Who. We did, it was their first final tour in 1982. Well it’s a Who final tour. I still have all the swag from that. But I was the tape op. Basically Glyn Johns is like using these huge Altec speakers for his — so I had to figure out a way to fit those into the big truck, it was a, we called it Black Peter, it was a big Peterbuilt Truck, a beautiful truck with an API console, and just decked out hardwood and stuff, just a gorgeous looking…
Were they recording every live concert?
